data.name: Sunita
data.long_meaning: Sunita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Suni' which means 'radiant' or 'brilliant'. It is a name of the Sun God's consort, Sushila or Surya Devi, who is also known as 'Savitri'. In Hindu mythology, Sunita symbolizes the power of the sun and its life-giving energy.
